audit.method: Read from the full term sheet by one AI reviewer, then checked against it twice by independent AI reviewers: first every line of the record against the document, then the document section by section against the record. Not signed off by a person. Every quote is looked up in the PDF text each time the tool runs.
audit.open_points:
The final record is at C:\Users\AFarid\Documents\Hackathon\key_credit_terms\data\audited\duke_energy_2025.json; the checker reports structure OK and 23 quotes exact, none loose, missing or on another page. No figure, party, date or status was wrong, and no term sat in the wrong row.

What the document cannot resolve:
1. The printed changed / unchanged flags (facility lines 2 and 3, accordion, leverage covenant line 2) rest on bold type that only the page image shows. I confirmed each on enlarged crops, but the checker can verify only the legend quote. In the Facility row the legend is not quoted at all, because the row is at the three-quote limit.
2. The summary gives no existing values for the changing terms other than facility size and maturity. The previous borrower sublimits and DUK's previous covenant level are unknown, so the lines say only "marked as new or changing".
3. The summary does not say which entities the 65% level applies to (read as the Borrowers other than DUK and Piedmont) and does not define "Operative" or "Maximum" sublimits or "(refresh)".
4. Interest Cover and Other stay "none" with status stated, derived from the Financial Covenants row. The separately posted Summary of Terms, which was not available, could add covenants.
5. The 20 silent rows stay not_stated. The summary is an extension and upsize of the existing facility, so its other terms probably continue, but the document does not say so.
6. "Sustainability-Linked Option: Removed" (a bolded changing term), pricing and upfront fees have no template row and reach the docx only through doc.notes and field notes.
7. Mapping the pricing grid's Borrower letters to the A to H labels of the sublimit table is read from layout; it is consistent in the image and affects only doc.notes.
8. The document carries no date; "2025" comes only from the file name, so doc.date is left empty.

doc.title: Executive Summary
doc.notes: One-page 'Executive Summary' slide (numbered 14; a 'Transaction Summary' paragraph above a terms table) for a one-year extension and $1.0bn upsize of Duke Energy Corporation's existing $9.0bn Senior Unsecured Master Credit Facility; all terms are on PDF page 1. It is an amendment, but only the proposed terms are shown (no existing / proposed columns): bolding (visible only in the page image) marks the new or changing terms, which are the facility size, the borrower sublimits, the maturity date, the extension options, the removal of the Sustainability-Linked Option, the 70% covenant level for DUK and the upfront fees. The list of Borrowers, the accordion, the LC and swingline sublimits, the reference rate, the CSA, the pricing grid, the 65% covenant level and Piedmont's 70% level are not bolded. It gives headline terms only and says 'Please refer to the Summary of Terms posted separately to the deal site for additional details', so guarantees, covenants other than the financial covenant, events of default, prepayment, transfer and reporting terms are not in it; those rows are 'not stated' rather than 'by reference' because the summary does not address them and does not say that terms it leaves out follow the existing facility (it says only that the Facility 'will also include amendments to certain terms as outlined below'). Pricing (1, 3 or 6-month SOFR + 10.0 bps CSA; a grid by unsecured ratings of facility fee 4.0 to 27.5 bps and all-in drawn pricing of SOFR + CSA + 62.5 to 175.0 bps, with each Borrower's current tier highlighted by its letter in the sublimit table: Duke Energy Progress at A/A2/A; Carolinas, Florida, Indiana and Piedmont at A-/A3/A-; Ohio and Kentucky at BBB+/Baa1/BBB+; Duke Energy Corporation at BBB/Baa2/BBB, i.e. 22.5 bps facility fee and SOFR + CSA + 150.0 bps all-in drawn), upfront fees (old money 6.0 bps, new money 17.5 bps) and the removal of the Sustainability-Linked Option are shown but have no row in the template.
